description: Live availability and prices for a property, read from the property's own booking engine. Returns the bookable room/rate options with total price in EUR for the whole stay (taxes included, city tax excluded), cancellation terms when the property provides them, and a room_key identifying each option. Can take up to 40 seconds.

checkin.description: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD (from tomorrow up to 12 months).

name: check_availability
